You are working in the repository at /Users/ab/Projects/php-ai-toolkit (branch main). Make exactly the following two changes and nothing else. Do not commit. Do not run tests. Do not touch any other file.

## Change 1: phpunit9.xml.dist

In the root file `phpunit9.xml.dist`, the `doctest` test suite currently reads:

```xml
        <testsuite name="doctest">
            <directory>tests/Doctest</directory>
        </testsuite>
    </testsuites>
    <listeners>
```

Replace that block so it reads:

```xml
        <testsuite name="doctest">
            <file>src/Doctest/Legacy/LegacyDoctestSuite.php</file>
        </testsuite>
    </testsuites>
    <php>
        <env name="DOCTEST_DIRECTORIES" value="src"/>
        <env name="DOCTEST_EXCLUDE" value="*/Doctest/DoctestExtension.php,*/Doctest/Configuration/ConfigurationLoader.php"/>
    </php>
    <listeners>
```

Keep every other line of the file byte-for-byte identical, including the NOTE comment on line 2, the indentation (4 spaces), and the `<listeners>` and `<coverage>` sections.

## Change 2: delete the project-local legacy suite

Delete the file `tests/Doctest/LegacyDoctestSuiteTest.php`, and then delete the now-empty directory `tests/Doctest`. It is replaced by the shipped suite `src/Doctest/Legacy/LegacyDoctestSuite.php`, which the configuration above now points at.

When done, print `git status --short` and the diff of `phpunit9.xml.dist`.
I’ll make the exact XML replacement, delete the local suite and empty directory, then print the requested status and diff. I won’t run tests or commit.
